ogTitle: Specialized Installation & Assembly | MA Soluciones Integrales
h1: Installation Services in Puntarenas and the Central Pacific
lead: We assemble and install specialized equipment and structures — from commercial furniture and HVAC to industrial machinery and modular buildings — with logistics, on-site assembly and functional testing.
heroAlt: Specialized assembly and installation team from MA Soluciones in Puntarenas, Costa Rica

faqs.q: What does the installation process involve?
faqs.a: We handle logistics, site preparation, assembly and functional testing, then hand over the installed equipment or structure with documentation. You deal with a single accountable team from start to finish.

faqs.q: Can you install equipment for an industrial facility?
faqs.a: Yes. We install industrial equipment, HVAC systems and modular structures in warehouses and workshops in Puntarenas and across the Central Pacific, coordinating with certified electricians when required.

faqs.q: Do you also install furniture and commercial fixtures?
faqs.a: Exactly. We assemble commercial furniture and store fixtures, and can coordinate interior installation alongside electrical and remodeling teams for a complete fit-out.
